# Platform support

<!-- Generated by scripts/docs.mjs from the product. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs`. -->

Jevris runs wherever Node.js runs the published package. What it may *do* inside a coding harness depends on a signed certification record for that harness, harness version range and operating system (SSOT §15.2, §15.4). Without one, Jevris observes and advises only: it never changes what the harness does.

## Runtime

| Requirement | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| Node.js | `^22.14.0 || >=23.6.0` |
| Architectures | x64, arm64 |
| Operating systems | macOS, Linux, Windows |
| Native modules | better-sqlite3 and @napi-rs/keyring ship prebuilt binaries for these; no compiler is needed |

## Harness certification

0 of 15 advertised combinations have an accepted certification record.

| Harness | OS | Status | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| claude | macOS | not certified | no certification record |
| claude | Linux | not certified | no certification record |
| claude | Windows | not certified | no certification record |
| kilocode | macOS | not certified | no certification record |
| kilocode | Linux | not certified | no certification record |
| kilocode | Windows | not certified | no certification record |
| codex | macOS | not certified | no certification record |
| codex | Linux | not certified | no certification record |
| codex | Windows | not certified | no certification record |
| opencode | macOS | not certified | no certification record |
| opencode | Linux | not certified | no certification record |
| opencode | Windows | not certified | no certification record |
| antigravity | macOS | not certified | no certification record |
| antigravity | Linux | not certified | no certification record |
| antigravity | Windows | not certified | no certification record |

"Not certified" means Jevris installs and observes in that harness, and `jevris doctor` reports the feature as unsupported or reduced. It does not route, add context or change a tool call there. Records are signed by the certification key in `assets/trust/release-keys.json` and expire; an expired record counts as none.
